variants.prompt: the wind-up pose: the white dragon rears its head and long neck up and back, mouth opening wide as if drawing a deep breath, wings spread fully open. No breath, no frost effects. Feet in the same place.

its second form: the deep-blue frozen heart in its chest is now cracked with bright white-blue cracks, the chest ice shattered around it, a few scales chipped off, the eyes sharper. Same size, same pose, same position.
